description.value:
Can't count on anyone? Count on this baby. Even a cowboy would ditch their six-gun for this.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 6 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Short Scope, Zenith • Mods: None

Special Features: Despite being Iconic, this weapon may load Non-Basic Ammunition. Incompatible with capacity modifying attachments. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 2d6 additional damage (6d6). When rolling for damage with this weapon, any damage die which land on a 1 are re-rolled until they result in a higher value. When this weapon inflicts a Critical Injury, it deals 5 additional Bonus Damage (15 Total). The first Turn in combat this weapon makes a Single Shot Attack, the user gains a +1 bonus to their Attack Check [Zenith].

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Short Scope, Zenith (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
